Define the entomology of an OpenMalaria scenario

Source: R/xml_export.R
define_OM_entomology.Rd

Writes the entomology of get_OM_ento_snippet into an openMalariaUtilities baseList, with openMalariaUtilities::defineEntomology(), and keeps it in the baseList, so that define_OM_vector_control uses the same mosquito populations and parameters.

The annualEIR of each population is its relative contribution to the EIR (see get_OM_ento_snippet(species_shares = )); the total EIR is scaledAnnualEIR. The seasonality gives the shape of the EIR over the year: numbers, or placeholders (by default "@m1@", ..., "@m12@", filled per scenario by columns m1, ..., m12). Placeholders need a recent openMalariaUtilities: older versions of defineEntomology() reject them with R >= 4.3.

The animal host parameters of each population are those of om_ento (its hosts_p), as in get_OM_xml: older versions of defineEntomology() wrote fixed values (0.95, 0.95, 0.99), which are replaced. The schema version is that of the baseList (OMVersion, 44 if absent); from schema 49, propInfected and propInfectious (removed from the schema) are not written.

Requires the openMalariaUtilities package.

Usage

define_OM_entomology(
  baseList,
  om_ento,
  seasonality = paste0("@m", 1:12, "@"),
  scaledAnnualEIR = "@EIR@",
  ...
)

Arguments

baseList

openMalariaUtilities baseList.

om_ento

Output of get_OM_ento_snippet.

seasonality

12 monthly (or 365 daily) values for all populations: non-negative numbers, or placeholders (default paste0("@m", 1:12, "@")); or a named list with one such vector per population (names as in om_ento$shares$mosquito).

scaledAnnualEIR

Total annual EIR: a number or a placeholder (default "@EIR@").

...

Passed to defineEntomology() (e.g. name, mode).

Value

The updated baseList.

See also

get_OM_ento_snippet, define_OM_vector_control
